text:
Today, you will be watching some individual people play on a game show. They will be betting on a spinning wheel. The prizes that they will receive, as well as the chance that they win, will vary from game to game. You will watch a total of 10 games.

On some trials, you will see the outcome on the wheel. On other trials, you will see the player's face. Sometimes, you might see both.

We will be asking you to guess how the player feels after finding out the result of each game.
